Once it ships, how long is delivery?
Delivery times depend on the carrier, shipping method, and destination once the order leaves the facility.
Standard ground shipping within the continental U.S. typically takes a few business days after shipment, while freight (LTL) deliveries for large items—like lift kits or fuel tanks—may require an appointment with the carrier.
